programme.desc: புகழ்பெற்ற கலைஞர்களால் நடத்தப்படும் தெய்வங்களைப் போற்றும் பிரபலமான பக்திப் பாடல்கள் தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: Tirupati Navaratri Brahmotsavam
programme.desc: Tirupati Navaratri Brahmotsavam.

programme.title: Navarathiri Sirappugal
programme.desc: On the auspicious occasion of Navaratri, various special programs are displayed ranging from a variety of events and activities.

programme.title: நல்ல காலம் பிறக்குது
programme.sub-title: A renowned astrologer provides a comprehensive insight into the position of stars and makes astrological predictions for the 12 zodiac signs
programme.desc: ஒரு பிரபல ஜோதிடர் நட்சத்திரங்களின் நிலையை பற்றிய விரிவான நுண்ணறிவை அளிப்பதோடு, 12 ராசிகளுக்கும் கணிப்புகளை வழங்குகிறார்.

programme.title: நியூஸ்
programme.sub-title: The host provides the latest information, advancements, and developments regarding various political, economic and social issues
programme.desc: அரசியல், பொருளாதார மற்றும் சமூகப் பிரச்சினைகள் தொடர்பான சமீபத்திய தகவல்கள், முன்னேற்றங்கள் மற்றும் முன்னேற்றங்கள்.

programme.title: வணக்கம் தமிழா
programme.sub-title: The hosts interact with renowned personalities and also present the latest updates from across the globe, ranging from entertainment to technology
programme.desc: தொகுப்பாளர்கள் பிரபல ஆளுமைகளுடன் தொடர்பு கொண்டு, உலகம் முழுவதிலுமிருந்து சமீபத்திய புதுப்பிப்புகளையும் வழங்குகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: ராமாயணம்
programme.sub-title: Lord Rama and various other figures in Valmiki's Ramayana and Tulsidas's 'Ramcharitmanas' go through trials and tribulations to achieve their goals and protect their loved ones
programme.desc: ராமர் இலக்குகளை அடையவும், தங்கள் அன்புக்குரியவர்களைப் பாதுகாக்கவும் சோதனைகள் மற்றும் இன்னல்களைக் கடந்து செல்கின்றனர்.

programme.title: எதிர்நீச்சல்
programme.sub-title: Janani and the women of the household embark on a journey to pursue their ambitions in the wake of Aadhimuthu Gunasekaran's downfall, while navigating the challenges of society
programme.desc: சமூகத்தின் சவால்களை எதிர்கொண்டு, தங்கள் லட்சியங்களைத் தொடர ஜனனியும் வீட்டுப் பெண்களும் ஒரு பயணத்தைத் தொடங்குகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: கயல்
programme.sub-title: Kayal, a selfless woman, earns to provide for her family after her father abandons them. Despite being overwhelmed with responsibilities, she puts her loved ones' well-being before her own happiness
programme.desc: தந்தைக்கு பின் குடும்ப பொறுப்புகளில் மூழ்கியுள்ள கயல், மகிழ்ச்சியை விட அன்புக்குரியவர்களின் நலனையே முன்னிறுத்துகிறாள்.

programme.title: கிச்சன் கலாட்டா
programme.sub-title: The host welcomes celebrity guests as they whip up their signature dishes alongside high-end chef creations, rustic village recipes and much more
programme.desc: விருந்தினர்கள் தங்களின் தனித்துவமான உணவுகளையும், சமையல் கலைஞர்களின் படைப்புகளையும், கிராமிய பாரம்பரிய சமையல் குறிப்புகளையும் மற்றும் பலவற்றையும் தயாரிக்கும்போது, ​​தொகுப்பாளர் அவர்களை வரவேற்கிறார்.

programme.title: பூங்கொடி
programme.sub-title: Poongodi's quest for self-establishment leads her to Saravanan, a man unwittingly controlled by his stepmother's manipulative ways
programme.desc: பூங்கொடியின் சுய தேடல் அவளை தன் மாற்றாந்தாயின் சூழ்ச்சிகளால் அறியாமலேயே கட்டுப்படும் சரவணனிடம் அழைத்துச் செல்கிறது.

programme.title: துளசி
programme.sub-title: A kind-hearted Tulasi strives hard to keep her family together and secure the happiness, well-being and future of her children at all costs
programme.desc: குடும்பத்தை ஒன்றாக வைத்துகொள்ளவும், குழந்தைகளின் மகிழ்ச்சி, நல்வாழ்வு மேலும் எதிர்காலத்தை பாதுகாக்கவும் பாடுபடும் துளசி.

programme.title: குறிஞ்சி
programme.sub-title: When circumstances compel an ambitious woman to wed a man with a tough personality, their initial friction slowly gives way to mutual understanding and eventually love
programme.desc: சூழ்நிலைகளின் நிர்ப்பந்தத்தால், லட்சியம் மிக்க ஒரு பெண், கடின குணமுடைய ஒரு ஆணை மணக்கிறாள். ஆரம்பகால முரண்பாடுகள் படிப்படியாக மறைந்து, பரஸ்பர புரிதலுக்கும் இறுதியில் காதலுக்கும் வழிவகுக்கிறது.

programme.title: அபிராமி
programme.sub-title: Abirami, a loving mother and devoted wife, places her family's happiness above all else. After enduring endless disrespect, she, with her daughter's support, sets out to rebuild her life
programme.desc: அன்பான தாயும் மனைவியுமான அபிராமி, தன் குடும்பத்தின் மகிழ்ச்சிக்கே முன்னுரிமை அளிக்கிறாள். எனினும், தொடர் அவமரியாதைகளை சந்தித்த பின், அவள் தன் மகளின் ஆதரவுடன் தன் வாழ்க்கையை மீண்டும் புதிதாகத் தொடங்குகிறாள்.

programme.title: சிறகுகள்
programme.sub-title: While weathering deep family turmoil, fate brings Dharmadurai and Parvathi together as they navigate greed and betrayal
programme.desc: கடினமான குடும்பச் சிக்கல்களைச் சமாளிக்கும் வேளையில், பேராசையையும் துரோகத்தையும் எதிர்கொள்ளும் தர்மதுரையையும் பார்வதியையும் விதி ஒன்று சேர்க்கிறது.

programme.desc: மகா செல்வத்தை திருமணம் செய்தபிறகும், தாய் வீட்டை ஆதரிக்க நினைக்கும்போது, தடைகளால் அவர்களின் குடும்பத்தில் சிக்கலானது.

programme.desc: ఒక మత గురువు కాథలిక్ సమాజానికి చెందిన వివిధ సాధువుల జీవితాలపై ఒక అంతర్దృష్టితో కూడిన ప్రసంగాన్ని అందిస్తున్నారు.

programme.title: మధురం నీ వాక్యం
programme.sub-title: A religious leader offers a reflective discourse on Christianity, highlighting the importance of the Holy Spirit's gifts and their role in nurturing a deeper, more fulfilling spiritual life
programme.desc: ఒక మతప్రబోధకుడు క్రైస్తవమతంపై ప్రసంగించి, పవిత్రాత్మ బహుమతుల ప్రాముఖ్యత, పరిపూర్ణమైన జీవితంలో వారి పాత్రను వివరిస్తారు.

programme.title: క్రీస్తు సందేశం ఫాదర్ గోపు ప్రకాష్
programme.sub-title: A religious leader elaborates on various teachings of the Almighty and encourages followers to embrace the path of spirituality
programme.desc: ఒక మతప్రబోధకుడు ప్రభువు వివిధ బోధలను బోధిస్తూ, అనుచరులను మతపరమైన మార్గాన్ని స్వీకరించమని ప్రోత్సహిస్తారు.

programme.title: వర్డ్ ఆఫ్ గాడ్
programme.sub-title: A Christian religious leader delivers a discourse based on the teachings of the Bible to lead devotees on the right path
programme.desc: భక్తులను సన్మార్గంలో నడిపించడానికి, ఒక క్రైస్తవ మత బోధకుడు బైబిల్ బోధనల ఆధారంగా ఒక ప్రసంగాన్ని అందిస్తారు.

programme.title: కరుణ జపమాల చాప్లెట్ ఆర్‌ఐపీ
programme.sub-title: Christian religious leaders and worshippers gather to recite holy verses from sacred texts and implore divine favour from the Almighty
programme.desc: మత ప్రబోధకులు, భక్తులు పవిత్ర గ్రంథాలలోని దివ్య వాక్యాలను పఠించడానికి, ప్రభువు అనుగ్రహాన్ని పొందడానికి సమావేశమవుతారు.

programme.title: గుడ్ సమరిటన్
programme.sub-title: The host showcases the noble work of good Samaritans and organisations dedicated to social service, charity and humanitarian efforts, by exploring their impact on society and their way of functioning
programme.desc: స్వచ్ఛంద పని చేసే పవిత్ర వ్యక్తులు మరియు సంస్థల గురించి మరియు వారి పనితీరు మార్గం గురించి తెలుసుకోండి.

programme.title: దివ్యవాక్కు
programme.sub-title: A spiritual leader offers a discourse replete with religious fervour to apprise devout Christians of divine providence and relevant teachings from the Bible
programme.desc: ఒక మతప్రబోధకుడు దైవ దర్శనం, బైబిలు బోధనల గురించి క్రైస్తవులకు తెలియచేయడానికి ఉత్సాహవంతమైన ప్రసంగం అందిస్తారు.

programme.title: జాయ్‌ఫుల్ మిస్టరీస్

programme.title: పునీతుల ప్రార్థన

programme.desc: పండితులు, భక్తులు శ్రీ వెంకటేశ్వర స్వామివారి కృపాకటాక్షాలు కోరుతూ మతపరమైన ఆచారాలను నిర్వహించి, భక్తి గీతాలు ఆలపిస్తారు.

programme.title: శ్రీ విష్ణు సహస్రనామ స్తోత్రం

programme.title: శ్రీరామ సుప్రభాతం
programme.sub-title: An all-encompassing collection of sacred and soulful hymns that are composed and performed at dawn to celebrate and praise Lord Rama
programme.desc: శ్రీరాముడిని స్తుతించడానికి, జరుపుకోవడానికి తెల్లవారుజామున కూర్చి పాడే పవిత్రమైన, మనోహరమైన శ్లోకాల యొక్క సమగ్ర సేకరణ.

programme.title: ఆంజనేయ సహస్రనామం
programme.sub-title: A Sanskrit hymn listing the 1,000 names of Lord Hanuman is recited to appease the Hindu deity and seek his divine blessings

programme.desc: एक आध्यात्मिक पथप्रदर्शक ध्यान के महत्व तथा मन, शरीर और प्रार्थना के बीच संबंध पर विस्तृत तरीके से प्रवचन प्रदान करते हैं।.

programme.title: जॉय ऑफ कृष्णा कान्शसनस
programme.sub-title: Religious leaders and devotees sing devotional songs and offer their sincere prayers to Lord Krishna, seeking his divine blessings
programme.desc: धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक और भक्तजन भजन गाते हैं और भगवान कृष्ण से सच्चे मन से प्रार्थना करते हुए उनका दिव्य आशीर्वाद मांगते हैं।.

programme.title: डिवोशनल मेलोज़
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of devotional hymns and songs are played back to back, praising the Almighty and seeking divine blessings
programme.desc: भक्ति भजनों और गीतों का एक व्यापक संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है, जिसमें ईश्वर की स्तुति की जाती है और दिव्य आशीर्वाद की कामना की जाती है।.

programme.title: जॉय ऑफ कृष्णा कान्शसनस
programme.sub-title: Religious leaders and devotees sing devotional songs and offer their sincere prayers to Lord Krishna, seeking his divine blessings
programme.desc: धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक और भक्तजन भजन गाते हैं और भगवान कृष्ण से सच्चे मन से प्रार्थना करते हुए उनका दिव्य आशीर्वाद मांगते हैं।.

programme.title: डिवोशनल मेलोज़
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of devotional hymns and songs are played back to back, praising the Almighty and seeking divine blessings
programme.desc: भक्ति भजनों और गीतों का एक व्यापक संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है, जिसमें ईश्वर की स्तुति की जाती है और दिव्य आशीर्वाद की कामना की जाती है।.

programme.title: जॉय ऑफ कृष्णा कान्शसनस
programme.sub-title: Religious leaders and devotees sing devotional songs and offer their sincere prayers to Lord Krishna, seeking his divine blessings
programme.desc: धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक और भक्तजन भजन गाते हैं और भगवान कृष्ण से सच्चे मन से प्रार्थना करते हुए उनका दिव्य आशीर्वाद मांगते हैं।.

programme.title: डिवोशनल मेलोज़
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of devotional hymns and songs are played back to back, praising the Almighty and seeking divine blessings
programme.desc: भक्ति भजनों और गीतों का एक व्यापक संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है, जिसमें ईश्वर की स्तुति की जाती है और दिव्य आशीर्वाद की कामना की जाती है।.

programme.title: जॉय ऑफ कृष्णा कान्शसनस
programme.sub-title: Religious leaders and devotees sing devotional songs and offer their sincere prayers to Lord Krishna, seeking his divine blessings
programme.desc: धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक और भक्तजन भजन गाते हैं और भगवान कृष्ण से सच्चे मन से प्रार्थना करते हुए उनका दिव्य आशीर्वाद मांगते हैं।.

programme.title: ஈஈ
programme.sub-title: A doctor wants to test lethal injections on unsuspecting slum dwellers, so Easwaran or E, who lives in the same slum and is a minor criminal, brings him to justice
programme.desc: உயிர் கொல்லி மருந்தை சேரி மக்களுக்கு சோதனை செய்யும் மருத்துவரை தடுத்து, அவனை சட்டத்துக்கு முன் நிறுத்தும் சிறிய ரவுடி ஈ.

programme.title: இந்தவார கலகலப்பு
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of hilarious comedy scenes, featuring popular artists, is played back-to-back for the entertainment of the viewers
programme.desc: கலைஞர்கள் பங்கேற்கும் நகைச்சுவைக் காட்சிகளின் தொகுப்பு பார்வையாளர்களின் பொழுதுபோக்கிற்காக தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: டான்சர்
programme.sub-title: An ambitious dancer with a disability faces a series of challenges in pursuit of his dreams, competing against opponents to win a competition
programme.desc: மாற்றுத்திறனாளியான நடன கலைஞர் தனது கனவுகளை தொடர சவால்களை எதிர்கொண்டு, போட்டியில் வெற்றிபெற எதிரிகளுடன் போட்டியிடுகிறார்.

programme.title: சாங்க்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of popular and famous songs produced and composed by talented musical artists is played back-to-back

programme.desc: புகழ்பெற்ற இசைக்கலைஞர்களால் இசையமைக்கப்பட்டு, தமிழ் திரைப்படங்களில் பல்வேறு கலைஞர்கள் நிகழ்த்திய மெல்லிசை பாடல்கள்.

programme.desc: உடற்பயிற்சி, தொழில்நுட்பம், நிதி, சமூகம், பொருளாதாரம் மற்றும் கலாச்சாரம் தொடர்பான பல்வேறு தலைப்புகள் குறித்த தகவல்கள்.

programme.title: ஸ்நேகிதியே
programme.sub-title: The host engages in discussions on topics related to women's issues, along with home and lifestyle tips
programme.desc: வீடு மற்றும் வாழ்க்கை முறை குறிப்புகளுடன் பெண்களின் பிரச்சினைகள் தொடர்பான தலைப்புகளில் விவாதங்களில் ஈடுபடுகிறது.

programme.title: அழகி
programme.sub-title: Sundari, a widow, raises her three children, Natraj, Mathi and Surya with love and support amidst several hardships. But, things turn bad in the family when Natraj gets married to a rich girl
programme.desc: விதவை சுந்தரியின் மூன்று மகன்களில் ஒருவரான நட்ராஜ் பணக்கார பெண்ணை மணக்கும்போது குடும்பத்தில் விஷயங்கள் மோசமாகிறது.

programme.title: கற்றது சமையல்
programme.sub-title: The host presents a wide range of delicious recipes, demonstrates their preparation and shares useful culinary tips with the viewers
programme.desc: எண்ணற்ற சுவையான சமையல் குறிப்புகளை வழங்குவதோடு, அவற்றை சமைத்து காண்பித்து மேலும், பயனுள்ள சமையல் குறிப்புகளை பகிர்கிறது.

programme.title: கோலங்கள்
programme.sub-title: Abhinaya, a hardworking woman, faces several hardships because of the people around her, including Adhitya, her stepbrother
programme.desc: கடின உழைப்பாளியான அபிநயா, தன்னைச் சுற்றியுள்ளவர்களால் பல கஷ்டங்களைச் சந்திக்கிறாள், அவளுடைய மாற்றாந்தாய் ஆதித்யா உட்பட.

credits.actor: Devayani,Deepa Venkat,Ajay Kapoor,Chandra Lakshman,Dheena Chandra Dhas,V Thiruselvam,Abhishek Shankar

programme.title: தென்றல்
programme.sub-title: A young girl named Thulasi dreams of continuing her education despite living with a middle-class family that shuns her
programme.desc: தன் கனவுகளை அடைய உதவும் காதலன் தமிழுடனான, துளசியின் காதலை அவர்களின் குடும்பங்கள் ஏற்காததால் உறவு சோதனைக்குள்ளாகிறது .

credits.actor: Shruthi Raj,Deepak Dinkar,Hemalatha,Suzane George,Shanthi Williams,Subhalekha Sudhakar,Sadhana,Aishwariyaa Bhaskaran

programme.title: மொஸ்கோவின் காவேரி
programme.sub-title: Moscow and Kaveri, two IT professionals, fall in love, buy a mansion and move in together. Now they must deal with the challenges of being in a live-in relationship
programme.desc: காதலர்களான மாஸ்கோ மற்றும் காவேரி, ஒரு வீட்டில் ஒன்றாக குடியேறி லிவ்-இன் உறவில் இருப்பதன் சவால்களை சமாளிக்க வேண்டும்.

credits.actor: Samantha Ruth Prabhu,Rahul Ravindran,Santhanam,Manikandan,Rohini,K. Selva Bharathy,Saravana Subbiah,Minnal Deepa

programme.title: நியூஸ்
programme.sub-title: The host presents the latest news stories and developments pertaining to various political and socio-economic issues around the country
programme.desc: நாடு முழுவதும் உள்ள பல அரசியல் மற்றும் சமூக-பொருளாதார பிரச்சினைகள் தொடர்பான சமீபத்திய செய்திகள் மற்றும் முன்னேற்றங்கள்.

programme.title: மதராசபட்டினம்
programme.sub-title: In the years leading to India's independence, a forbidden romance blooms between a British woman and an Indian man, challenging the boundaries of love and colonialism in pre-independence Madras
programme.desc: இந்தியா சுதந்திரம் பெறுவதற்கு முந்தைய மெட்ராஸில் காலனித்துவத்தை மீறி காதலிக்கும் பிரிட்டிஷ் பெண்ணும் இந்திய ஆணும்.

credits.actor: Arya (Parithi),Amy Jackson (Amy),Cochin Hanifa (Nambi),Carole Trangmar-Palmer (Amy Wilkinson 'Duraiyamma'),Alexx O'Nell (Robert Ellis),Mike Parish (The Rev M. Smith),Nassar (Ayyakannu)

programme.title: இந்தவார கலகலப்பு
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of hilarious comedy scenes, featuring popular artists, is played back-to-back for the entertainment of the viewers
programme.desc: கலைஞர்கள் பங்கேற்கும் நகைச்சுவைக் காட்சிகளின் தொகுப்பு பார்வையாளர்களின் பொழுதுபோக்கிற்காக தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: ராமானுஜர்
programme.sub-title: Ramanuja, a learned philosopher, travels the subcontinent and brings his teachings to ardent followers of the Hindu faith
programme.desc: கற்றறிந்த தத்துவஞானியான ராமானுஜம் நாடு முழுதும் சென்று இந்து மதத்தின் தீவிரப் பக்தர்களுக்கு தனது போதனைகளை கற்பிக்கிறார்.

programme.title: பிரியமானவள்
programme.sub-title: A gentle mother enjoys an idyllic existence alongside her spouse and offspring. However, a resentful companion secretly schemes to seize her fortune
programme.desc: பாசமுள்ள ஒரு தாய் தன் கணவர் மற்றும் பிள்ளைகளுடன் நிம்மதியான வாழ்க்கை வாழ்கிறாள். இருப்பினும், பொறாமை கொண்ட ஒரு நண்பர் அவளது செல்வத்தை அபகரிக்க இரகசியமாகத் திட்டமிடுகிறார்.

programme.title: கண்ணெதிரே தோன்றினாள்
programme.sub-title: Rathnam exchanges newborn babies Sakthi and Anitha to grant riches to his child. Therefore, Rudra faces destiny because Anitha grows improperly
programme.desc: ரத்னம் தன் குழந்தைக்கு சொத்து கிடைப்பதற்காக பிறந்த குழந்தைகளான சக்தி மற்றும் அனிதாவை மாற்றிவைக்கிறார், அதன் விளைவாக, அனிதா சரியாக வளராததால் ருத்ரா விதியை எதிர்கொள்கிறார்.

credits.actor: Malavika Avinash,Rekha Krishnappa,Papri Ghosh,Swetha Khelge,Vaishu Jayachandhiran,Jeevan G. Vaa,Kavitha Solairaja,Jayshri Jue,Ramachandran Mahalingam (Rathnam)

programme.sub-title: A journalist falls for an enigmatic woman who does not reciprocate his feelings. However, after he decides to marry another, the woman appears at his doorstep asking for help
programme.desc: பத்திரிகையாளர் தன் உணர்வுகளுக்கு ஈடுகொடுக்காத ஒரு பெண்ணை காதலித்து,வேறுபெண்ணை மணக்க எண்ணியபோது அவள் உதவி கோரி வருகிறாள்.

credits.actor: Shah Rukh Khan,Manisha Koirala,Preity G Zinta,Raghubir Yadav,Sabyasachi Chakrabarty,Piyush Mishra,Mita Vasisht,Arundhati Rao

programme.title: சர்வைவிங்க் அர்த்
programme.sub-title: Against all odds, an alpha male gorgonopsid fights to protect his family from predators and the deadly heat that surrounds them at every turn
programme.desc: An eight-part docuseries exploring Earth's major eras and extinction events across 450 million years alongside the creatures who fought to survive.

programme.title: ஜப்பான்'ஸ் வைல்ட் சைட்
programme.sub-title: As winter's harshest period passes, the changing season ushers in new life and fresh challenges for Japan's wildlife
programme.desc: ஹொக்கைடோவின் காடுகள் முதல் ஒகினாவாவின் கடற்கரைகள் வரை, ஜப்பானின் விலங்குகளின் இரகசியங்களை வெளிக்கொணரும் ஒரு ஆவணப்படம்.

programme.title: லா விடா என் எல் ஆஃப்ரிக்கா ஆர்டெண்ட்
programme.sub-title: Being thin, having black patches on light-coloured fur, hyperventilating and licking itself regularly to evaporate saliva are the cheetah's most effective tricks to cope with its scorching environment
programme.desc: உலகின் வெப்பமான பகுதிகளில் ஏற்படும் காலநிலை மாற்றம், மாறிவரும் சூழலுக்கு விலங்குகள் தங்களை மாற்றிக் கொள்வதை பற்றி அறிக.

programme.title: கேவ் க்ரோக்ஸ் ஆஃப் கபான்
programme.sub-title: Experts and cavers investigate a community of dwarf crocodiles living in a series of underground caves in the wilderness of Gabon
programme.desc: காங்கோவின் ஆழமான குகைகளுக்கு மத்தியில் வசிக்கும் முதலைகள் கூட்டத்தின் வாழ்வையும் உயிர்வாழும் தந்திரங்களையும் ஆராய்கிறது.

programme.title: ஹிப்போஸ் ஆஃப்டர் டார்க்
programme.sub-title: Some of the most amazing hippo behaviour happens after dark
programme.desc: அகச்சிவப்பு தொழில்நுட்பத்தின் மூலம், இரவின்போது காடுகளில் உள்ள நீர்யானைகள் தொடர்பான நிகழ்வுகளை வழங்கும் இயக்குனர்.

programme.title: லயன் க்வீன்ஸ்: ஃபைட்டிக் ஃபார் சர்வைவல்
programme.sub-title: Every year in Tanzania, the dry season hits the Ruaha reserve hard. To survive, animal populations come down from the high plateaus to reach the Ruaha river, where a troupe of lionesses waits patiently, poised for combat
programme.desc: தங்கள் நிலத்தை மற்ற காட்டு விலங்குகளுடன் பகிர வேண்டிய சூழ்நிலையில் ருஹாவின் சிங்கங்கள் புதிய உத்திகளை பயன்படுத்துகின்றன.

programme.title: ஆஃப்ரிக்கா'ஸ் ட்ரீஸ் ஆஃப் லைஃப்
programme.sub-title: Explore the importance of the sausage tree in sub-Saharan Africa's ecosystem and the vital role it plays in providing sustenance and sanctuary for local animals
programme.desc: ஆப்பிரிக்க வனவிலங்குகள் மற்றும் பல்லுயிர்களுக்கு ஆதரவாக உள்ள மரங்கள் மற்றும் அவற்றின் சூழலியல் முக்கியத்துவம்.

programme.title: வைல்ட் பை நேச்சர்
programme.sub-title: WILD BY NATURE is a television series about wild nature, which deals with the endemic fauna of Mexico, narrated from a fresh, intrepid, and original point of view with a message of conservation and care for our species. Our protagonist, the actor and naturalist Arturo Islas travels through the going into their jungles, deserts, and seas in search of the wonderful species of fauna: mammals, birds, reptiles, amphibians, fish, and insects. WILD BY NATURE is a great experience of adventure and knowledge of natural wealth
programme.desc: பல வாழ்விடங்கள் மற்றும் விலங்குகளை ஆராய்ந்து, அவற்றைப் பற்றிய சுவாரஸ்யமான உண்மைகளை பகிரும் இயற்கை ஆர்வலரான ஆர்துரோ.

programme.title: வைல்ட் பை நேச்சர்

programme.title: சர்வைவிங்க் அர்த்
programme.sub-title: A heartwarming coming-of-age story about a hatchling who grows to be a leader of her herd, helping ensure the survival of future generations
programme.desc: An eight-part docuseries exploring Earth's major eras and extinction events across 450 million years alongside the creatures who fought to survive.

programme.title: ஆஃப்ரிக்கா'ஸ் ட்ரீஸ் ஆஃப் லைஃப்
programme.sub-title: Explore the importance of the camel thorn in sub-Saharan Africa's ecosystem and the vital role it plays in providing sustenance and sanctuary for local animals
programme.desc: ஆப்பிரிக்க வனவிலங்குகள் மற்றும் பல்லுயிர்களுக்கு ஆதரவாக உள்ள மரங்கள் மற்றும் அவற்றின் சூழலியல் முக்கியத்துவம்.

programme.title: தி அமெரிக்காஸ்
programme.sub-title: Mexico, where deserts meet tropics; see new footage of fledgling pygmy owls, orca hunting, new species in flooded caves and orchid bees filmed in incredible detail -- all revealing the hidden lives of unique wildlife
programme.desc: Tom Hanks narrates a 10-episode television event exploring the worlds and wildlife of North and South America, following amazing creatures across frozen mountains, barren deserts and dense jungles in awe-inspiring, never-before-seen footage.

programme.title: ஒகவாங்கோ: ரிவர் ஆஃப் ட்ரீம்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: The extraordinary landscape and wildlife of the middle world of the Okavango River in Southern Africa
programme.desc: ஒகவாங்கோ நதியின் சுற்றுச்சூழல் அமைப்பைப் பற்றிய விரிவான பார்வை, இது பல்வேறு வகையான வனவிலங்குகளைக் காட்சிப்படுத்துகிறது.

programme.title: தி கில்
programme.sub-title: A pride of lionesses reigns supreme on the banks of a river in Tanzania. They are merciless hunters, unrivalled in their fearlessness and strength
programme.desc: தான்சானியாவின் நதிக்கரையில் வாழும் பெண் சிங்கங்கள், தண்ணீர் மற்றும் இரை பற்றாக்குறைக்கு மத்தியில் உயிர்வாழ போராடுகின்றன.

programme.title: தி வியூ ஃப்ரம் ஆன் ஹை
programme.sub-title: Exploring how the meticulously planned architectural features of Saint Petersburg were constructed, with a particular focus on their sacral meanings
programme.desc: ரஷ்யாவின் இரண்டாவது பெரிய நகரமான செயின்ட் பீட்டர்ஸ்பர்க்கில் உள்ள நினைவுச் சின்னங்கள் மற்றும் கட்டிடங்களின் வரலாறு மற்றும் கட்டிடக்கலையை பற்றி விளக்கும் ஒரு ஆவணப்படம்.

programme.title: வைல்ட் கேட்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: Explores the daily activities of predatory wild cats residing in the forests of America while capturing their unseen intimacy with their families
programme.desc: மிகவும் சவாலான சில பகுதிகளில் உயிர்வாழ்வதற்காகப் போராட தங்கள் திறன்களைப் பயன்படுத்தும் தீய காட்டு பூனைகளின் பல இனங்கள்.

programme.title: பிக் கேட்ஸ்: அன் அமேசிங் அனிமல் ஃபேமிலி
programme.sub-title: Patrick Aryee comes within a whisker of some of Earth's most majestic predators as he embarks on a remarkable journey through the feline family tree
programme.desc: காடுகளில் ஆதிக்கம் செலுத்தும் 37 வகையான வேட்டை பூனைகளின் வெற்றியையும், அவற்றின் குடும்ப மரத்தையும் பற்றிய ஒரு ஆவணப்படம்.

programme.title: பிக் கேட்ஸ்: அன் அமேசிங் அனிமல் ஃபேமிலி
programme.sub-title: As Patrick Aryee delves into the feline family tree, the biologist witnesses gravity-defying 'catrobatics', tests the speed of a cheetah, and explores the odd-looking Pallas's cat
programme.desc: காடுகளில் ஆதிக்கம் செலுத்தும் 37 வகையான வேட்டை பூனைகளின் வெற்றியையும், அவற்றின் குடும்ப மரத்தையும் பற்றிய ஒரு ஆவணப்படம்.

programme.title: வைல்ட் கிங்டம்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: Arid and unforgiving, deserts push their inhabitants to the extreme. From the desert elephant to the shovel-snouted lizard, see how they survive

programme.title: శివ
programme.sub-title: Shiva is a brave and intelligent child who stays with his grandparents in Vedas City. He sets out with his gang of friends to save the citizens from all sorts of evil
programme.desc: వేదాస్ నగరంలో తన బామ్మాతాతాలతో నివసించే ధైర్యంగల శివ, మిత్రులతో కలిసి తన నగరాన్ని దుష్ట శక్తుల నుండి కాపాడాలనుకుంటాడు.

credits.actor: Nilufer Middey,Sonal Kaushal,Rupa Bhimani,Anamay Verma,Aditya Jaiswal,Brij Bhushan Sawhney,Manoj Pandey

programme.title: శివ
programme.sub-title: Shiva is a brave and intelligent child who stays with his grandparents in Vedas City. He sets out with his gang of friends to save the citizens from all sorts of evil
programme.desc: వేదాస్ నగరంలో తన బామ్మాతాతాలతో నివసించే ధైర్యంగల శివ, మిత్రులతో కలిసి తన నగరాన్ని దుష్ట శక్తుల నుండి కాపాడాలనుకుంటాడు.

credits.actor: Nilufer Middey,Sonal Kaushal,Rupa Bhimani,Anamay Verma,Aditya Jaiswal,Brij Bhushan Sawhney,Manoj Pandey

programme.title: పాక్ పకావు
programme.sub-title: Follow the whimsical and absurd conversations of two friends and learn new things as they navigate life's everyday mysteries
programme.desc: ఇద్దరు స్నేహితుల విచిత్రమైన, మరియు అసంబద్ధమైన సంభాషణలను అనుసరించండి మరియు వారు జీవితంలోని కొత్త విషయాలను నేర్చుకోండి.

programme.title: పక్డమ్ పక్డై
programme.sub-title: There is a constant war between Doggy Don and the three clever mice who live in his house. However, with the help of Doggy Don's brother, an ex-army dog, they fight the mice to win back their house
programme.desc: తన ఇంట్లో మూడు ఎలుకలతో నిరంతరం యుద్ధం చేసే డాగీ డాన్, మాజీ ఆర్మీ కుక్కతో కలిసి తమ ఇంటిని సొంతం చేసుకోడానికి పోరాడతాడు.

programme.title: జిగ్ షార్కో హీరో విలన్స్ జీరో
programme.sub-title: Zig, a hyena, eagerly tries to eat Marina, a mermaid. But Marina's friend Sharko protects her from Zig's impending attacks
programme.desc: జిగ్ అనే హైనా, మెరీనా అనే మత్యకన్యను తినడానికి ప్రయత్నించగా,ఆమె మిత్రుడు షార్కో, జిగ్ చేసే దాడుల నుండి ఆమెను కాపాడుతాడు.

programme.title: పక్డమ్ పక్డాయి డాగీ డాన్ వర్సెస్ బిల్లిమాన్
programme.sub-title: Doggy Don and Colonel face major trouble when their journey turns into an absolute disaster. Moreover, Billiman turns into a rogue conqueror
programme.desc: డాగీ డాన్, అతని అన్నయ్య కల్నల్, ముగ్గురు అల్లరి ఎలుకలతో పోరాడటానికి బిల్లిమాన్ అనే సూపర్‌హీరో సహాయం కోరతారు.

programme.title: పక్డమ్ పక్డై
programme.sub-title: There is a constant war between Doggy Don and the three clever mice who live in his house. However, with the help of Doggy Don's brother, an ex-army dog, they fight the mice to win back their house
programme.desc: తన ఇంట్లో మూడు ఎలుకలతో నిరంతరం యుద్ధం చేసే డాగీ డాన్, మాజీ ఆర్మీ కుక్కతో కలిసి తమ ఇంటిని సొంతం చేసుకోడానికి పోరాడతాడు.

programme.title: జిగ్ అండ్ షార్కో
programme.sub-title: Zig the hyena lives all alone on a desert island and schemes to eat Marina
programme.desc: జిగ్ అనే హైనా, మెరీనా అనే మత్స్యకన్యను తినడానికి ప్రయత్నిస్తుంది, కానీ ఆమె మిత్రుడు షార్కో ఆమెని జిగ్ నుండి కాపాడతాడు.

credits.director: Olivier Jean-Marie,Andrés Fernández,Cédric Dietsch,Khalil Ben Naamane,Yani Ouabdesselam,Nicolas Bougard,Pierre-Gilles Stehr

programme.title: పినాకి అండ్ హ్యాపీ -ది భూత్ బంధుస్
programme.sub-title: Pinaki and his family of ghosts embark on spooky adventures and a series of fun and slapstick comedy as they try to fit in the outside world
programme.desc: పినాకి, అతని దెయ్యాల కుటుంబం బయటి ప్రపంచంలో ఇమిడిపోవడానికి ప్రయత్నిస్తూ, భయానక సాహసాలు, హాస్య సంఘటనల పరంపరలో పయనిస్తారు.

credits.actor: Sonal Kaushal,Rajesh Kava,Manoj Pandey,Aranya Kaur,Pawan Kalra,Meghna Erande,Bhakti Jhaveri,Pooja Punjabi

programme.title: Pinaki and Happy

programme.title: శివ
programme.sub-title: Shiva is a brave and intelligent child who stays with his grandparents in Vedas City. He sets out with his gang of friends to save the citizens from all sorts of evil
programme.desc: వేదాస్ నగరంలో తన బామ్మాతాతాలతో నివసించే ధైర్యంగల శివ, మిత్రులతో కలిసి తన నగరాన్ని దుష్ట శక్తుల నుండి కాపాడాలనుకుంటాడు.

credits.actor: Nilufer Middey,Sonal Kaushal,Rupa Bhimani,Anamay Verma,Aditya Jaiswal,Brij Bhushan Sawhney,Manoj Pandey

programme.title: పాక్ పకావు
programme.sub-title: Follow the whimsical and absurd conversations of two friends and learn new things as they navigate life's everyday mysteries
programme.desc: ఇద్దరు స్నేహితుల విచిత్రమైన, మరియు అసంబద్ధమైన సంభాషణలను అనుసరించండి మరియు వారు జీవితంలోని కొత్త విషయాలను నేర్చుకోండి.

programme.title: పక్డమ్ పక్డై
programme.sub-title: There is a constant war between Doggy Don and the three clever mice who live in his house. However, with the help of Doggy Don's brother, an ex-army dog, they fight the mice to win back their house
programme.desc: తన ఇంట్లో మూడు ఎలుకలతో నిరంతరం యుద్ధం చేసే డాగీ డాన్, మాజీ ఆర్మీ కుక్కతో కలిసి తమ ఇంటిని సొంతం చేసుకోడానికి పోరాడతాడు.

programme.title: పినాకి అండ్ హ్యాపీ -ది భూత్ బంధుస్
programme.sub-title: Pinaki and his family of ghosts embark on spooky adventures and a series of fun and slapstick comedy as they try to fit in the outside world
programme.desc: పినాకి, అతని దెయ్యాల కుటుంబం బయటి ప్రపంచంలో ఇమిడిపోవడానికి ప్రయత్నిస్తూ, భయానక సాహసాలు, హాస్య సంఘటనల పరంపరలో పయనిస్తారు.

credits.actor: Sonal Kaushal,Rajesh Kava,Manoj Pandey,Aranya Kaur,Pawan Kalra,Meghna Erande,Bhakti Jhaveri,Pooja Punjabi

programme.title: रथम
programme.sub-title: While investigating his friend's murder, Ranjith, a journalist, unearths the sinister network responsible for a series of crimes
programme.desc: अपने दोस्त की हत्या की जांच करते समय, पत्रकार रंजीत को कई अपराधों के लिए जिम्मेदार खतरनाक नेटवर्क का पता चलता है।.

credits.actor: Mahima Nambiar (Sangeetha/Annapoorani Sebastian),Vijay Antony (Ranjith Kumar),Misha Ghoshal (Bharathi/Nisha),Jagan (Arivukarasu),Kalairani (Raniamma),Ameya (Annapoorani),John Mahendran (Inspector Vimal Raj),Uday Mahesh (K. Jayaraj),Nandita Swetha (Madhumitha),Nizhalgal Ravi (Rathna Pandian),Riya Manoj (Arumpavai),Boys Rajan (Police Inspector)

programme.title: अंबुल्ला घील्ली
programme.sub-title: Ghilli, a dog, navigates through several challenges and experiences with his owner as both of them attempt to win the hearts of their lovers
programme.desc: घिल्ली नामक कुत्ता अपने मालिक के साथ कई चुनौतियों और अनुभवों से गुजरते हैं और वे दोनों अपने प्रेमियों का दिल जीतने की कोशिश करते हैं।.

credits.actor: Maithreya Rajasekar (Ramu),Dushara Vijayan (Anvitha),Chandini Tamilarasan (Bhargavi),Mime Gopi (Sundaram),Nanjil Vijayan (Ramu's friend),Soori (Ghilli)

programme.title: राजा विक्रमार्क

programme.title: స్మాషింగ్ సింబా
programme.sub-title: Simmba, an honest and courageous police officer, teams up with his fearless colleagues in his mission to confront and defeat the evil forces of society
programme.desc: నిజాయితీగల, ధైర్యవంతుడైన పోలీసు అధికారి సింబా, తన సహచరులతో కలిసి సమాజంలోని దుష్ట శక్తులను ఎదుర్కొవాలనుకుంటాడు.

programme.title: స్మాషింగ్ సింబా

programme.title: ఛోటా భీమ్
programme.sub-title: Bheem is an extremely brave, strong and intelligent young boy. He often manages to solve everyone's problems which endears him to the townspeople of Dholakpur
programme.desc: చాలా ధైర్యవంతుడు, బలమైన, తెలివైన బాలుడు భీమ్, ఢోలక్‌పూర్‌ పట్టణవాసుల సమస్యలన్నింటినీ పరిష్కరించగలుగుతాడు.

credits.actor: Vatsal Dubey (Chhota Bheem),Julie Tejwani (Raju),Rupa Bhimani (Chutki),Sabina Malik Mausam (Kalia),Rajesh Kava (Jaggu),Prince Patel (Takiya)

programme.title: లిటిల్ కృష్ణ
programme.sub-title: Little Krishna, a mischievous child, lives in the village of Vrindavan. He decides to save the villagers from an evil king, Kamsa, who sends ferocious demons upon them
programme.desc: కొంటెవాడైన చిన్ని కృష్ణుడు, ప్రజలపైకి భయంకర రాక్షసులను పంపిన దుష్ట కంసుడి నుండి బృందావన ప్రజలను కాపాడాలనుకుంటాడు.

credits.actor: Prachi Save Saathi,Meghna Erande,Neil D'Monte,Anand Tiwari,Vikrant Chaturvedi,Soniya Nair,Cara Pareira

programme.title: లిటిల్ కృష్ణ మెడ్లీస్
programme.sub-title: Little Krishna has fun getting caught up in all sorts of mischief with his friends in Vrindavan. But when the evil Kansa sends his minions to disrupt his life, he jumps into action
programme.desc: బృందావనంలో తన స్నేహితులతో కలిసి అల్లరి చేస్తూ సరదాగా తిరిగే శ్రీకృష్ణుడు, కంసుడి రాక్షసులను అంతం చేయడానికి సిద్దమవుతాడు.

programme.title: ఛోటా భీమ్ ఇన్ డ్రాగన్స్ కా ఆఖరి యుద్ధ్
programme.sub-title: When a powerful dragon wreaks havoc in Dholakpur, Chhota Bheem and his friends set out on a challenging quest to defeat the evil and restore peace
programme.desc: ఛోటా భీమ్, అతని మిత్రులు కలిసి ఢోలక్‌పూర్‌లో విధ్వంసం సృష్టిస్తున్న డ్రాగన్ ను ఓడించి, శాంతిని పునరుద్దరించాలనుకుంటారు.

programme.sub-title: Follow the hilarious misadventures of Sampat and Champat, two bumbling thieves who constantly hatch chaotic plans that backfire, landing them in endless trouble with the local police

programme.title: ఓమి నెం.1

programme.sub-title: Bheem is an extremely brave, strong and intelligent young boy. He often manages to solve everyone's problems which endears him to the townspeople of Dholakpur

programme.title: ఛోటా భీమ్
programme.sub-title: Bheem is an extremely brave, strong and intelligent young boy. He often manages to solve everyone's problems which endears him to the townspeople of Dholakpur
programme.desc: చాలా ధైర్యవంతుడు, బలమైన, తెలివైన బాలుడు భీమ్, ఢోలక్‌పూర్‌ పట్టణవాసుల సమస్యలన్నింటినీ పరిష్కరించగలుగుతాడు.

credits.actor: Vatsal Dubey (Chhota Bheem),Julie Tejwani (Raju),Rupa Bhimani (Chutki),Sabina Malik Mausam (Kalia),Rajesh Kava (Jaggu),Prince Patel (Takiya)

programme.title: లిటిల్ కృష్ణ
programme.sub-title: Little Krishna, a mischievous child, lives in the village of Vrindavan. He decides to save the villagers from an evil king, Kamsa, who sends ferocious demons upon them
programme.desc: కొంటెవాడైన చిన్ని కృష్ణుడు, ప్రజలపైకి భయంకర రాక్షసులను పంపిన దుష్ట కంసుడి నుండి బృందావన ప్రజలను కాపాడాలనుకుంటాడు.

credits.actor: Prachi Save Saathi,Meghna Erande,Neil D'Monte,Anand Tiwari,Vikrant Chaturvedi,Soniya Nair,Cara Pareira

programme.title: లిటిల్ కృష్ణ మెడ్లీస్
programme.sub-title: Little Krishna has fun getting caught up in all sorts of mischief with his friends in Vrindavan. But when the evil Kansa sends his minions to disrupt his life, he jumps into action
programme.desc: బృందావనంలో తన స్నేహితులతో కలిసి అల్లరి చేస్తూ సరదాగా తిరిగే శ్రీకృష్ణుడు, కంసుడి రాక్షసులను అంతం చేయడానికి సిద్దమవుతాడు.

programme.title: ఛోటా భీమ్
programme.sub-title: A released evil queen, Deheshatika, seeks to transform Dholakpur but is blocked by mystical relics. As a result, Bheem must find and protect these relics to stop her conquest

programme.title: బాహుబలి ఫ్రెండ్స్: రైజ్ ఆఫ్ ఆపరశత్రు
programme.sub-title: Little Singham and all his Bahubali friends unite to confront the diabolic Aparshatru and try to stop his execution of evil plans
programme.desc: లిటిల్ సింగం, అతడి బాహుబలి మిత్రులు కలిసి అపరశత్రు అనే దుర్మార్గుడి ప్రణాళికలను అడ్డుకోడానికి ప్రయత్నిస్తారు.

programme.title: లిటిల్ సింగం బాహుబలి ఫ్రెండ్స్ రివెంజ్ ఆఫ్ అపరశత్రు
programme.sub-title: Upon discovering Mirchi Nagar's peril, Little Singham and his Bahubali friends quickly mobilize to confront the evil demon Aparshatru and his destructive Pralay Astra
programme.desc: లిటిల్ సింగం,అతని బాహుబలి మిత్రులు దుష్ట రాక్షసుడైన అపరశత్రు,తన విధ్వంసకర ప్రళయ అస్త్రాన్ని ఎదుర్కోవడానికి సిద్ధమవుతారు.

programme.title: బాహుబలి ఫ్రెండ్స్: రైజ్ ఆఫ్ మహిషాసుర్
programme.sub-title: When the town is under the deadly grip of Mahishasur, the mighty demon, Little Singham and his Bahubali friends come together to stop the monster's malicious plans
programme.desc: తమ పట్టణాన్ని గుప్పెట్లో పెట్టుకున్న మహిషాసురుడిని అడ్డుకోడానికి లిటిల్ సింగం, అతడి బాహుబలి స్నేహితులు చేతులు కలుపుతారు.

programme.title: గ్రిజ్జీ అండ్ ద లెమ్మింగ్స్
programme.sub-title: Grizzy, a bear, lives in the forest ranger's house every time he leaves and considers it as his own. However, things change when a tribe of lemmings moves into the same house
programme.desc: గ్రిజ్జీ అనే ఎలుగుబంటి ఒక అటవీ రేంజర్ ఇంటిని తన సొంత నివాసంగా భావిస్తుంది, అయితే లెమ్మింగ్స్ రాకతో పరిస్థితి మారుతుంది.

credits.director: Victor Moulin,Cédric Lachenaud,Alexandre Wahl,Corentin Lecourt,Clément Girard,Idriss Benseghir,Célestine Jacquel-Plays

programme.title: గ్రిజ్జీ అండ్ ద లెమ్మింగ్స్
programme.sub-title: Grizzy, a bear, lives in the forest ranger's house every time he leaves and considers it as his own. However, things change when a tribe of lemmings moves into the same house
programme.desc: గ్రిజ్జీ అనే ఎలుగుబంటి ఒక అటవీ రేంజర్ ఇంటిని తన సొంత నివాసంగా భావిస్తుంది, అయితే లెమ్మింగ్స్ రాకతో పరిస్థితి మారుతుంది.

programme.title: సంపత్ చంపత్
programme.sub-title: Follow the hilarious misadventures of Sampat and Champat, two bumbling thieves who constantly hatch chaotic plans that backfire, landing them in endless trouble with the local police
programme.desc: సంపత్, చంపత్ అనే ఇద్దరు చేతకాని దొంగలు నిరంతరం స్థానిక పోలీసుల చిక్కుల్లో పడే హాస్యభరితమైన సాహసాలను అనుసరించండి.

programme.title: లిటిల్ సింగం
programme.sub-title: Little Singham, an honest but ferocious police officer, fights against injustice and defends his town from formidable enemies
programme.desc: నిజాయితీపరుడైన పోలీసు అధికారి లిటిల్ సింగం అన్యాయానికి వ్యతిరేకంగా పోరాడుతూ, శత్రువుల నుండి తన పట్టణాన్ని కాపాడతాడు.

programme.desc: A collection of footage from cycling events, featuring some of the greatest cycling action from around the world.

programme.title: Red Bull Batalla
programme.desc: 20 years of Spanish freestyle, from the first International Final to the anniversary in Buenos Aires.

programme.title: Chumbo: Made for Big Wave Surfing
programme.desc: Getting a glimpse into surfer Lucas Chianca's incredible life as the Brazilian waterman balances chasing heavy waves around the world with his biggest challenge yet, becoming a father for the first time.

programme.title: Castles in the Sky
programme.desc: This film was shot in five countries for more than three years. It's a documentary that gathers top surfers during insane adventures. As soon as they get on a plane, they have the whole world to explore.

programme.title: Paradigm
programme.desc: From the precision of slopestyle to the massive airs of freeride and the raw speed of downhill, Thomas Genon, Szymon Godziek, Emil Johansson, and Kade Edwards deliver raw MTB talent and nonstop action.

programme.title: Life of Kai
programme.sub-title: Kai Lenny surfs the same swell at both Jaws and Mavericks, then confronts the risks versus rewards of big wave surfing after suffering a serious injury at Pipeline, the most dangerous wave in the world
programme.desc: Ride shotgun with Kai Lenny as he redefines what's possible in the world's biggest waves, chasing his dreams to become the ultimate waterman.

programme.title: Red Bull Cliff Diving World Series
programme.sub-title: A breathtaking venue pushes Morgane Herculano and Jonathan Paredes to question their career choices
programme.desc: Athletes compete to execute acrobatic dives from great heights in the Red Bull Cliff Diving World Series, a major diving tournament.

programme.title: WRC: More Than Machine
programme.sub-title: The M-Sport test their drivers for the upcoming season, determined to find the next leading contender. Step behind the scenes to see how these young drivers battle adversity
programme.desc: Series following members of the M-Sport WRC team about the trials and tribulations of competing in Rally driving at the highest level.

programme.title: BIKE: The Search for Milliseconds - Jackson Goldstone
programme.desc: On the final day of the World Cup season, downhill MTB rider Jackson Goldstone prepares to risk it all to win.

programme.title: WRC: More Than Machine
programme.sub-title: Talented rookie driver Martins Sesks and his teammates at M-Sport take on some of the most challenging stages of the season - Poland, and his native Latvia
programme.desc: Series following members of the M-Sport WRC team about the trials and tribulations of competing in Rally driving at the highest level.

programme.title: Red Bull Soapbox Race
programme.sub-title: Elysian Park in Los Angeles is turned into an obstacle-littered course for the day as 70 teams of adrenaline junkies put their gravity-powered contraptions to the test
programme.desc: All the thrills and spills from the Red Bull Soapbox Race as teams of racers test themselves by hurtling down challenging, obstacle-filled courses in homemade, motorless soapbox race cars.

programme.title: Beyond the ROX
programme.sub-title: Sadiq Elfitouri shares the transition from football to HYROX, and OCR World Champion Ida Mathilde makes a spectacular debut, as the fast-growing sport draws athletes from all fields
programme.desc: The best HYROX athletes uncover what it takes to rise to the top.

programme.title: Red Bull Stalen Ros
programme.sub-title: This wild water race tests speed, teamwork and balance as riders try to stay dry on a fun and tricky course
programme.desc: Teams try to navigate a track over water which includes obstacles on their customised bicycles.

programme.title: Fine Lines
programme.desc: What could compel us to abandon our most basic instinct for self-preservation? It's not about adrenaline or thrill seeking. There is something far deeper that drives the world's most elite group of mountain adventurers to take life-threatening risks.

programme.title: Beyond the ROX
programme.sub-title: After years of training, Jake Dearden reaches the Elite 15. Now he faces the world's best. Can he prove he belongs in the 2024/25 season?
programme.desc: The best HYROX athletes uncover what it takes to rise to the top.

programme.title: WRC: More Than Machine
programme.sub-title: Tensions reach a boiling point at the end of the season as the M-Sport team takes on Central Europe and Japan. And, their marquee driver reveals his plans for 2025 and beyond
programme.desc: Series following members of the M-Sport WRC team about the trials and tribulations of competing in Rally driving at the highest level.

programme.title: ANYTIME
programme.desc: A group of elite riders including Tommy G are determined to push the frontiers of MTB freeride.

programme.title: Resilience: The Els Visser Story
programme.desc: How does surviving a ship wreck lead to someone becoming a successful triathlete? Learn about Els Visser's journey from medical student to sporting success via a life-threatening disaster at sea.

programme.title: Skate Tales
programme.sub-title: Madars and Nico Hiraga explore how San Francisco is shaping skateboarding's new generation
programme.desc: Skateboarder Madars Apse travels the world to skate with and learn from people pushing the culture of skateboarding in their own special way.

programme.title: Red Bull Flugtag
programme.sub-title: Perfect conditions mean it's a great day for flying in Switzerland, and 50 teams are ready to try their luck. They'll try to make it as far as they can in their crazy homemade flying machines before plunging into Lake Zurich
programme.desc: Named after the German word for 'flying day', Red Bull Flugtag challenges the brave and brainy to design, build and pilot human-powered flying machines off an 8.5m flight deck over water.

programme.title: MTB RAW
programme.sub-title: To become one of the world's best MTB slopestyle riders it takes a dedication to training in the right conditions. Step inside Matt Jones' secret compound to find out what it takes to beat the best
programme.desc: See what happens when the talent and creativity of filmmakers and MTB athletes is combined. A special kind of magic emerges, including incredible riding with ground-breaking filmmaking for the ultimate two-wheeled rush.

programme.title: Munch
programme.desc: Noa Deane hits Australia for heavy slabs, punts and air sections with Ozzy Wrong in a wild surf adventure.

programme.title: Skate Tales
programme.sub-title: Madars travels to Brazil to uncover Tiago Lemos's rise from the streets to global skate stardom
programme.desc: Skateboarder Madars Apse travels the world to skate with and learn from people pushing the culture of skateboarding in their own special way.

programme.title: Red Bull Rampage
programme.sub-title: A dozen female mountain bike athletes compete in this invitation-only freeride event. After creating their own lines in the red-rock landscape of Utah, watch them showcase their skill and creativity
programme.desc: An invitation-only freeride mountain bike competition held near Zion National Park in Virgin, Utah.

programme.title: Natural Heights
programme.sub-title: In Flatanger, Norway, Jakob Schubert tackles the first ascent of 'B.I.G.' (9c) with unyielding resolve
programme.desc: Follow two parallel stories: climbers battling gravity to conquer new heights, while navigating their journeys off the wall.

programme.title: Nazaré: Making Giants
programme.desc: Local prodigies and surfers do everything to get their invite to the Nazaré Big Wave Challenge.

credits.actor: Pedro Scooby,Kai Lenny,Lucas Chumbo,Rodrigo Koxa,Justine Dupont

programme.title: Natural Heights
programme.sub-title: Nika Potapova wants to become a pro climber, but no matter the sacrifices, the outcome is far from guaranteed
programme.desc: Follow two parallel stories: climbers battling gravity to conquer new heights, while navigating their journeys off the wall.

programme.title: No Contest: Off Tour
programme.sub-title: While Japan is known for both tradition and technology it's also an archipelago lashed by swell and steeped in surfing culture. Kanoa Igarashi takes you to Tokyo to get a taste of the action
programme.desc: Exploring the communities of surfing's international hot zones. Includes a look at Italy, Fiji, urban surf cities like NYC and Tel Aviv, and the jungles of Central America and South Brazil.

programme.title: A Biker's Ballad
programme.desc: Celebrating the deep-rooted culture of mountain biking by taking a two two-wheeled journey back to where the sport began in Crested Butte, Colorado.

programme.title: Skate Tales
programme.sub-title: Madars Apse heads to Montréal for the Dime Glory Challenge. With Alexis Lacroix and Ryan Decenzo he explores the city's skate scene before stepping into the chaos of skateboarding's most fun event
programme.desc: Skateboarder Madars Apse travels the world to skate with and learn from people pushing the culture of skateboarding in their own special way.

programme.title: Red Bull Flugtag
programme.sub-title: Forty dauntless teams will attempt to fly questionably designed homemade machines over the Ohio River, aiming to reach Indiana's distant shore
programme.desc: Named after the German word for 'flying day', Red Bull Flugtag challenges the brave and brainy to design, build and pilot human-powered flying machines off an 8.5m flight deck over water.

programme.desc: This wildlife documentary follows Hugh Fearnley-Whittingstall and a team of experts as they travel across seas to find the world's most extraordinary animal stories. The series focuses on animal intelligence, exploring remarkable behaviours, relationships and actions of various species. In Florida, Hugh discovers the unusual relationship between the predatory alligator and the placid manatee, while zoologist Lucy Cooke travels to Canada to reveal how raccoons are cleverly adapting to city life. Biologist Patrick Aryee is in Cambodia to explore why the Sun Bear is one of the world's shrewdest animals and conservationist Giles Clark discusses elephants and emotional intelligence while in Kenya.

programme.title: Happily Never After
programme.desc: The marriage vow \"till death do us part\" lives up to its promise for the couples featured in \"Happily Never After.\" It's a wedding show and police drama rolled into one, as the best days in the lives of brides and grooms tragically turn when homicides crash the honeymoons. Each episode tells the true story -- narrated by actress Marlo Thomas -- of a newlywed's murder, interspersed with flashbacks to happier days for the couple. Dr. Wendy Walsh, who holds a Ph.D. in clinical psychology and is a co-host on the syndicated program \"The Doctors,\" offers commentary on the behavioral twists and turns in each story.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Dan Short fell in love with cars when he first laid eyes on a 1967 Camaro. He bought a used model as a teenager, but because he couldn't pay someone else to restore it, he learned how to do the work himself. After a stint in the Army, Short decided to make his passion for classic cars his life's work, and FantomWorks was born. Today the Norfolk, Va., company is the largest auto restoration shop in the U.S., and this reality series shows how Short and his team meticulously refurbish some of America's favorite rides. Drama ensues in the form of personality clashes, cost overruns, irate customers and other issues, which are compounded by Short's reputation as a straight shooter who won't accept substandard results.

programme.title: बब्लू डबलू
programme.sub-title: An evil logger decides to turn the forest into his personal lumberyard. However, things change after Bablu and Dablu, two bear brothers, decide to stop him
programme.desc: एक दुष्ट लकड़हारा जंगल को अपना निजी लकड़हारा बनाने का फ़ैसला करता है। लेकिन, दो भालू भाइयों, बबलू और डबलू, द्वारा उसे रोकने के फ़ैसले के बाद चीज़ें बदल जाती हैं।.

programme.title: 12 ज्योतिर्लिंग दर्शन
programme.sub-title: Devotees come together to participate in a pilgrimage to visit the 12 Jyotirlingas, which are considered a divine manifestation of Lord Shiva
programme.desc: भक्तगण 12 ज्योतिर्लिंगों के दर्शन हेतु तीर्थयात्रा में भाग लेने के लिए एकत्रित होते हैं, जिन्हें भगवान शिव का दिव्य स्वरूप माना जाता है।.

programme.title: धर्म कथा
programme.sub-title: A religious leader sheds light on the teachings of the Almighty and encourages followers to take the path of spirituality
programme.desc: एक धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक, ईश्वर की शिक्षाओं पर प्रकाश डालते हैं और अनुयायियों को आध्यात्मिकता का मार्ग अपनाने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करते हैं।.

programme.title: भक्ति प्रवाह
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of ancient hymns and spiritual verses chanted in order to praise the Almighty is played back to back
programme.desc: यह कार्यक्रम, परमेश्वर की स्तुति के लिए संगीतबद्ध किए गए प्राचीन भजनों और आध्यात्मिक छंदों का व्यापक संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है।.

programme.title: भूत बॉस (पाप-ओ-मीटर)
programme.sub-title: Bhoot Boss, Thakela and Pakela are ghosts who seek out people that have sinned and teach them a lesson to reduce wrongdoings in the world. However, their mission lands them in precarious situations
programme.desc: भूत बॉस, थकेला और पकेला भूत हैं जो पाप करने वाले लोगों को ढूंढ उन्हें सबक सिखाते हैं। हालांकि, उनका मिशन उन्हें अनिश्चित परिस्थितियों में डाल देता है।.

programme.title: जानबाज़ मुर्गा
programme.sub-title: A fun-loving chicken along with his friends embark on various adventures, as they overcome challenges and share heartfelt moments
programme.desc: एक मौज-मस्ती पसंद करने वाला मुर्गा अपने दोस्तों के साथ विभिन्न साहसिक कार्यों पर निकलता है, जहां वे चुनौतियों पर विजय प्राप्त करते हैं और दिल को छू लेने वाले पल साझा करते हैं।.

programme.title: गुरु और भोले
programme.sub-title: Two close friends, Guru and Bhole, live in the quaint little town of Surtaal Nagar in North India. They always end up in sticky situations but have a musical adventure while trying to get out of it
programme.desc: दो जिगरी दोस्त गुरु और भोले, उत्तर भारत के एक अनोखे और पुराने छोटे शहर, सुर-ताल नगर में रहते हैं। वे अक्सर किसी न किसी मुसीबत में फँस जाते हैं लेकिन साहसिक कारनामे करते हुए उनसे बहार निकल आते हैं।.

programme.title: हनी बनी व़ाइटी
programme.sub-title: Honey and Bunny, two pet cats, engage in various adventures with other pets when Miss Katkar, their owner, goes out of the house
programme.desc: दो पालतू बिल्लियाँ हनी और बनी, जब उनकी मालकिन मिस काटकर घर से बाहर जाती हैं, तो वे अन्य पालतू जानवरों के साथ कई तरह के रोमांच में शामिल हो जाती हैं।.

programme.title: गुरु और भोले
programme.sub-title: Two close friends, Guru and Bhole, live in the quaint little town of Surtaal Nagar in North India. They always end up in sticky situations but have a musical adventure while trying to get out of it
programme.desc: दो जिगरी दोस्त गुरु और भोले, उत्तर भारत के एक अनोखे और पुराने छोटे शहर, सुर-ताल नगर में रहते हैं। वे अक्सर किसी न किसी मुसीबत में फँस जाते हैं लेकिन साहसिक कारनामे करते हुए उनसे बहार निकल आते हैं।.

programme.title: मद्दाम सर
programme.sub-title: Four brave female police officers of Aminabad police station use their wittiness and emotional intelligence to tackle the various challenges they face at their work
programme.desc: अमीनाबाद पुलिस स्टेशन की चार बहादुर महिला पुलिस अधिकारी अपने कार्यस्थल की विभिन्न चुनौतियों से निपटने के लिए अपनी बुद्धिमता और भावनात्मक बुद्धिमत्ता का उपयोग करती हैं।.

programme.title: 12 ज्योतिर्लिंग दर्शन
programme.sub-title: Devotees come together to participate in a pilgrimage to visit the 12 Jyotirlingas, which are considered a divine manifestation of Lord Shiva
programme.desc: भक्तगण 12 ज्योतिर्लिंगों के दर्शन हेतु तीर्थयात्रा में भाग लेने के लिए एकत्रित होते हैं, जिन्हें भगवान शिव का दिव्य स्वरूप माना जाता है।.

programme.title: धर्म कथा
programme.sub-title: A religious leader sheds light on the teachings of the Almighty and encourages followers to take the path of spirituality
programme.desc: एक धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक, ईश्वर की शिक्षाओं पर प्रकाश डालते हैं और अनुयायियों को आध्यात्मिकता का मार्ग अपनाने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करते हैं।.

programme.title: भक्ति प्रवाह
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of ancient hymns and spiritual verses chanted in order to praise the Almighty is played back to back
programme.desc: यह कार्यक्रम, परमेश्वर की स्तुति के लिए संगीतबद्ध किए गए प्राचीन भजनों और आध्यात्मिक छंदों का व्यापक संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है।.

programme.title: भूत बॉस (पाप-ओ-मीटर)
programme.sub-title: Bhoot Boss, Thakela and Pakela are ghosts who seek out people that have sinned and teach them a lesson to reduce wrongdoings in the world. However, their mission lands them in precarious situations
programme.desc: भूत बॉस, थकेला और पकेला भूत हैं जो पाप करने वाले लोगों को ढूंढ उन्हें सबक सिखाते हैं। हालांकि, उनका मिशन उन्हें अनिश्चित परिस्थितियों में डाल देता है।.

programme.title: जानबाज़ मुर्गा
programme.sub-title: A fun-loving chicken along with his friends embark on various adventures, as they overcome challenges and share heartfelt moments
programme.desc: एक मौज-मस्ती पसंद करने वाला मुर्गा अपने दोस्तों के साथ विभिन्न साहसिक कार्यों पर निकलता है, जहां वे चुनौतियों पर विजय प्राप्त करते हैं और दिल को छू लेने वाले पल साझा करते हैं।.

programme.desc: एक धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक, ईश्वर की शिक्षाओं पर प्रकाश डालते हैं और अनुयायियों को आध्यात्मिकता का मार्ग अपनाने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करते हैं।.

programme.title: भक्ति प्रवाह
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of ancient hymns and spiritual verses chanted in order to praise the Almighty is played back to back
programme.desc: यह कार्यक्रम, परमेश्वर की स्तुति के लिए संगीतबद्ध किए गए प्राचीन भजनों और आध्यात्मिक छंदों का व्यापक संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है।.

programme.title: भूत बॉस (पाप-ओ-मीटर)
programme.sub-title: Bhoot Boss, Thakela and Pakela are ghosts who seek out people that have sinned and teach them a lesson to reduce wrongdoings in the world. However, their mission lands them in precarious situations
programme.desc: भूत बॉस, थकेला और पकेला भूत हैं जो पाप करने वाले लोगों को ढूंढ उन्हें सबक सिखाते हैं। हालांकि, उनका मिशन उन्हें अनिश्चित परिस्थितियों में डाल देता है।.

programme.title: जानबाज़ मुर्गा
programme.sub-title: A fun-loving chicken along with his friends embark on various adventures, as they overcome challenges and share heartfelt moments
programme.desc: एक मौज-मस्ती पसंद करने वाला मुर्गा अपने दोस्तों के साथ विभिन्न साहसिक कार्यों पर निकलता है, जहां वे चुनौतियों पर विजय प्राप्त करते हैं और दिल को छू लेने वाले पल साझा करते हैं।.

programme.title: हनी बनी
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: टेलीविजन के सर्वश्रेष्ठ कार्यक्रमों की प्रस्तुति।.

programme.title: टेलीशॉपिंग
programme.sub-title: The host showcases the features of a variety of products manufactured by renowned brands that can be purchased from the comfort of one's home
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता प्रसिद्ध ब्रांडों द्वारा निर्मित विभिन्न प्रकार के उत्पादों की विशेषताओं को प्रदर्शित करते हैं, जिन्हें घर बैठे आराम से खरीदा जा सकते हैं।.

programme.title: बब्लू डबलू
programme.sub-title: An evil logger decides to turn the forest into his personal lumberyard. However, things change after Bablu and Dablu, two bear brothers, decide to stop him
programme.desc: एक दुष्ट लकड़हारा जंगल को अपना निजी लकड़हारा बनाने का फ़ैसला करता है। लेकिन, दो भालू भाइयों, बबलू और डबलू, द्वारा उसे रोकने के फ़ैसले के बाद चीज़ें बदल जाती हैं।.

programme.title: टेलीशॉपिंग
programme.sub-title: The host showcases the features of a variety of products manufactured by renowned brands that can be purchased from the comfort of one's home

programme.title: मद्दाम सर
programme.sub-title: Four brave female police officers of Aminabad police station use their wittiness and emotional intelligence to tackle the various challenges they face at their work
programme.desc: अमीनाबाद पुलिस स्टेशन की चार बहादुर महिला पुलिस अधिकारी अपने कार्यस्थल की विभिन्न चुनौतियों से निपटने के लिए अपनी बुद्धिमता और भावनात्मक बुद्धिमत्ता का उपयोग करती हैं।.

programme.title: हनी बनी व़ाइटी
programme.sub-title: Honey and Bunny, two pet cats, engage in various adventures with other pets when Miss Katkar, their owner, goes out of the house
programme.desc: दो पालतू बिल्लियाँ हनी और बनी, जब उनकी मालकिन मिस काटकर घर से बाहर जाती हैं, तो वे अन्य पालतू जानवरों के साथ कई तरह के रोमांच में शामिल हो जाती हैं।.

programme.title: गुरु और भोले
programme.sub-title: Two close friends, Guru and Bhole, live in the quaint little town of Surtaal Nagar in North India. They always end up in sticky situations but have a musical adventure while trying to get out of it
programme.desc: दो जिगरी दोस्त गुरु और भोले, उत्तर भारत के एक अनोखे और पुराने छोटे शहर, सुर-ताल नगर में रहते हैं। वे अक्सर किसी न किसी मुसीबत में फँस जाते हैं लेकिन साहसिक कारनामे करते हुए उनसे बहार निकल आते हैं।.

programme.desc: दो जिगरी दोस्त गुरु और भोले, उत्तर भारत के एक अनोखे और पुराने छोटे शहर, सुर-ताल नगर में रहते हैं। वे अक्सर किसी न किसी मुसीबत में फँस जाते हैं लेकिन साहसिक कारनामे करते हुए उनसे बहार निकल आते हैं।.

programme.title: मद्दाम सर
programme.sub-title: Four brave female police officers of Aminabad police station use their wittiness and emotional intelligence to tackle the various challenges they face at their work
programme.desc: अमीनाबाद पुलिस स्टेशन की चार बहादुर महिला पुलिस अधिकारी अपने कार्यस्थल की विभिन्न चुनौतियों से निपटने के लिए अपनी बुद्धिमता और भावनात्मक बुद्धिमत्ता का उपयोग करती हैं।.

credits.actor: Bhavika Sharma,Gulki Joshi,Sonali Pandit Naik,Yukti Kapoor,Rahil Azam,Ajay Jadhav,Yashkant Sharma,Priyanshu Singh

programme.title: क्राइम पैट्रोल
programme.sub-title: The host presents dramatised re-enactments of real-life crime cases that revolve around harassment, kidnapping and murder
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता, उत्पीड़न, अपहरण और हत्या पर आधारित वास्तविक जीवन के आपराधिक मामलों का नाटकीय रूपांतरण प्रस्तुत करते हैं।.

credits.director: Darshan Raj,Durgesh Peharwar,Navdeep Dahiya,Gaurav Rana,Amit Kumar Jha,Shailendra Singh Tomar,Nadeem Ahmed,Shreya Dudheria,Vinod Kumar Singh
credits.actor: Anoop Soni,Saakshi Tanwar,Diwakar Pundir,Shakti Anand,Sanjeev Tyagi,Nissar Khan,Manish Raj Sharma,Sonali Kulkarni,Divyanka Tripathi,Ashutosh Rana,Renuka Shahane

programme.title: हनी बनी
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: टेलीविजन के सर्वश्रेष्ठ कार्यक्रमों की प्रस्तुति।.

programme.title: योगा
programme.sub-title: A yoga expert shares detailed techniques to improve flexibility, boost energy and reduce stress, offering a holistic approach to physical and mental wellness
programme.desc: एक योग विशेषज्ञ, शरीर के लचीलेपन में सुधार, ऊर्जा बढ़ाने और तनाव को कम करने की विस्तृत तकनीक साझा करते हैं, साथ ही शारीरिक और मानसिक स्वास्थ के लिए समग्र दृष्टिकोण प्रदान करते हैं।.

programme.title: ஆசை 100 வகை
programme.sub-title: A series of dramatised re-enactments of cases revolving around various horrifying and unscrupulous activities that conspire in society
programme.desc: சமூகத்தில் சதி செய்யும் பல்வேறு திகிலூட்டும் மற்றும் நேர்மையற்ற செயல்களைச் சுற்றியுள்ள வழக்குகளின் தொடர்ச்சியான நாடகமாக்கப்பட்ட மறு-நடவடிக்கைகள்.

programme.title: மிக்ஸ்டேப் பாடல்கள்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of some of the most popular and beloved musical numbers from the year, played consecutively
programme.desc: வருடத்தில் மிகவும் பிரபலமான மற்றும் பிரியமான சில இசை எண்களின் விரிவான தொகுப்பு, தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்பட்டது.

programme.title: Baal Krishna
programme.desc: Krishna, the young son of Devaki and Vasudeva, embarks on a series of adventures where he befriends the people of Vrindavan, his hometown, and saves them from difficulties.

credits.actor: Nimai Bali,Meet Mukhi,Sachin Shroff,Deshna Dugad,Ram Awana

programme.title: கணபதியே வருவாய்
programme.sub-title: After Lord Shiva beheads Ganesha, Goddess Parvati asks for his resurrection with an elephant's head. Despite facing many challenges after this, Ganesha transforms from an ostracized child into the most beloved deity
programme.desc: சிவன் கணேசனின் தலையை துண்டித்த பிறகு, பார்வதி தேவி யானை தலையுடன் மீண்டும் உயிர்ப்பிக்குமாறு கோரியபின், சவால்களை எதிர்கொண்டு, கணேசன் ஒதுக்கப்பட்ட குழந்தையிலிருந்து மிகவும் விரும்பப்படும் தெய்வமாகிறார்.

programme.title: கால பைரவன்
programme.sub-title: Jogeshwari is the daughter of Dakshan who hates Shiva and worships Vishnu. When Dakshan forces Jogeshwari to marry, she rebels because of her dedication towards Bhairavan, a devout devotee of Shiva
programme.desc: சிவனை வெறுத்து விஷ்ணுவை வழிபடும் தட்சன், அவரது மகள் ஜோகேஸ்வரியை திருமணம் செய்ய வற்புறுத்தும்போது, அவளோ சிவனின் தீவிர பக்தரான பைரவன் மீதான தனது பக்தியின் காரணமாக எதிர்க்கிறாள்.

programme.title: மூவி
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: திரைப்படங்களில் சிறந்தவை.

programme.title: அண்ணாமலை
programme.sub-title: Generations of rivalry come to light as two families fight for control of a revered temple while personal emotions complicate the path to peace
programme.desc: தனிப்பட்ட உணர்வுகள் அமைதிக்கான பாதையை சிக்கலாக்கும் அதே வேளையில், ஒரு புனிதமான கோவிலின் கட்டுப்பாட்டிற்காக இரண்டு குடும்பங்கள் சண்டையிடுவதால், தலைமுறையாக இருந்துவரும் அவர்களின் பகைமை வெளிச்சத்திற்கு வருகிறது.

credits.actor: Sivakumar,Radikaa Sarathkumar,Shyam Ganesh,Kuyili,Ponvannan,Viji Chandrasekhar,Shanmuga Sundaram,Jyothi Lakshmi

programme.title: தாமரை
programme.sub-title: Sneha and Dwarkesh fall in love, and they secretly register their marriage. However, their relationship is tested as they face various obstacles
programme.desc: காதலர்களான சினேகாவும் துவாரகேஷும் ரகசியமாக பதிவு திருமணம் செய்து கொள்கிறார்கள். ஆனால், அவர்கள் பல்வேறு தடைகளைச் சந்திக்கும் பொழுது அவர்களின் உறவு சோதிக்கப்படுகிறது.

credits.director: K.J Thangapandiyan,Hafees,A. Ramachandran,M.K. Arunthavaraja,S. Anand Babu

programme.title: Selvi
programme.desc: Selvi, a young girl, has academic ambition that she wants to pursue by moving to the city from her village. However, her family wants her to get married.

programme.title: அம்மன்
programme.sub-title: Sakthi is blessed by the Goddess Amman with the power to foresee the future. Her life takes an unexpected turn when she meets an atheist doctor
programme.desc: அம்மன் தேவியால் சக்தி எதிர்காலத்தை கணிக்கும் அருளை பெறுகிறாள். அவள் ஒரு நாத்திக மருத்துவரை சந்திக்கும்போது, அவளது வாழ்க்கை எதிர்பாராத திருப்பத்தை அடைகிறது.

credits.actor: Pavithra Gowda (Sakthi),Amaljith (Eshwar),Nivisha (Durga),Surjith Ansary (Kishore),Nanditha Jennifer (Saradha),Nisha Jagadeeswaran (Logambal),Shaliy Avinesh (Logambal),Shobana (Naga),Anita Nair (Lakshmi),Rathan Ganapathy (Mahendran),Avinash Ashok (Aravindh),Anu Sulash (Neha),Shubha Raksha (Inba)

programme.title: கணபதியே வருவாய்
programme.sub-title: After Lord Shiva beheads Ganesha, Goddess Parvati asks for his resurrection with an elephant's head. Despite facing many challenges after this, Ganesha transforms from an ostracized child into the most beloved deity
programme.desc: சிவன் கணேசனின் தலையை துண்டித்த பிறகு, பார்வதி தேவி யானை தலையுடன் மீண்டும் உயிர்ப்பிக்குமாறு கோரியபின், சவால்களை எதிர்கொண்டு, கணேசன் ஒதுக்கப்பட்ட குழந்தையிலிருந்து மிகவும் விரும்பப்படும் தெய்வமாகிறார்.

programme.title: கர்ணா
programme.sub-title: Karna, the son of the Sun God and Kunti, faces hardships from birth but strives to prove his worth. Overcoming challenges, he rises to become one of the most formidable archers and warriors in the Mahabharata
programme.desc: பிறப்பிலிருந்தே பல சவால்களை தாண்டி மகாபாரதத்தில் சிறந்த வில்லாளி மற்றும் போர்வீரராகும் சூரியன், குந்தியின் மகன் கர்ணன்.

programme.title: தெனாலி ராமன்
programme.sub-title: Tenali Raman, an advisor at the court of King Krishnadevaraya, uses his sharp presence of mind and wisdom to solve the difficult matters of the kingdom and its people daily
programme.desc: தனது கூர்மையான மனதையும் ஞானத்தையும் பயன்படுத்தி, ராஜ்ஜியம் மற்றும் மக்களின் கடினமான விஷயங்களை தீர்க்கும் தெனாலி ராமன்.

credits.actor: Krishna Bharadwaj,Pankaj Berry,Manav Gohil,Jitendra Pathak,Sohit Soni,Sanjay Mangnani,Priyamvada Kant,Nimisha Vakharia

programme.title: காயத்திரி
programme.sub-title: Gayathri, a young girl, works as a postwoman to support her family. However, she struggles to overcome various tribulations
programme.desc: இளம்பெண் காயத்திரி, தனது குடும்பத்தை ஆதரிப்பதற்காக தபால்காரராக பணிபுரிகிறார். இருப்பினும், அவள் பல்வேறு இன்னல்களை கடக்க போராடுகிறாள்.

programme.title: அலாதின்

programme.title: సర్వైవింగ్ ఎర్త్
programme.sub-title: Against all odds, an alpha male gorgonopsid fights to protect his family from predators and the deadly heat that surrounds them at every turn
programme.desc: An eight-part docuseries exploring Earth's major eras and extinction events across 450 million years alongside the creatures who fought to survive.

programme.title: జపాన్స్ వైల్డ్ సైడ్
programme.sub-title: As winter's harshest period passes, the changing season ushers in new life and fresh challenges for Japan's wildlife
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు జపాన్‌లోని ప్రసిద్ధ జంతువుల రహస్యాలను కనుగొనడానికి హోక్కైడో అడవుల నుండి ఒకినావా తీరప్రాంతాల వరకు ప్రయాణిస్తారు.

programme.title: లా విడా ఎన్ ఎల్ ఆఫ్రికా ఆర్డియంటే
programme.sub-title: Being thin, having black patches on light-coloured fur, hyperventilating and licking itself regularly to evaporate saliva are the cheetah's most effective tricks to cope with its scorching environment
programme.desc: The threat of climate change is especially a risk for those living in the world's hottest regions, such as the Namib, the Kalahari and the Kaokoveld in the southern cone of Africa.

programme.title: కేవ్ క్రాక్స్ ఆప్ గబాన్
programme.sub-title: Experts and cavers investigate a community of dwarf crocodiles living in a series of underground caves in the wilderness of Gabon
programme.desc: చిత్ర దర్శకుడు కాంగోలోని లోతైన గుహల మధ్య నివసించే మొసళ్ల సమూహం జీవితాలను, మనుగడ వ్యూహాలను అన్వేషిస్తారు.

programme.title: హిప్పోస్ ఆఫ్టర్ డార్క్
programme.sub-title: Some of the most amazing hippo behaviour happens after dark
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు సింహాల అహంకారం, హిప్పోల మంద మధ్య రాత్రి పడుతుండగా భయంకరమైన ఎద్దు రక్షణలో మనుగడ కోసం పోరాటాన్ని చూపుతారు.

programme.title: లయన్ క్వీన్స్: ఫైటింగ్ ఫర్ సర్వైవల్
programme.sub-title: Every year in Tanzania, the dry season hits the Ruaha reserve hard. To survive, animal populations come down from the high plateaus to reach the Ruaha river, where a troupe of lionesses waits patiently, poised for combat
programme.desc: తమ భూభాగంలో నివసించే రుహాలోని ఆడసింహాలు భూమిని ఇతర అడవి జంతువులతో పంచుకోవలసి వచ్చినప్పుడు కొత్త వ్యూహాలు సిద్ధంచేస్తాయి.

programme.title: ఆఫ్రికాస్ ట్రీస్ ఆఫ్ లైఫ్
programme.sub-title: Explore the importance of the sausage tree in sub-Saharan Africa's ecosystem and the vital role it plays in providing sustenance and sanctuary for local animals
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు, సబ్-సహారా ఆఫ్రికా పర్యావరణంలో వివిధరకాల చెట్ల ప్రాముఖ్యత, స్థానిక జంతువుల జీవితంలో వాటి పాత్రను అన్వేషిస్తారు.

programme.title: వైల్డ్ బై నేచర్
programme.sub-title: WILD BY NATURE is a television series about wild nature, which deals with the endemic fauna of Mexico, narrated from a fresh, intrepid, and original point of view with a message of conservation and care for our species. Our protagonist, the actor and naturalist Arturo Islas travels through the going into their jungles, deserts, and seas in search of the wonderful species of fauna: mammals, birds, reptiles, amphibians, fish, and insects. WILD BY NATURE is a great experience of adventure and knowledge of natural wealth
programme.desc: నటుడు, ప్రకృతి శాస్త్రవేత్త ఆర్థర్ ఇస్లాస్ అనేక రకాల జంతువుల ఆవాసాలు, వాటికి సంబంధించిన ఆసక్తికర విషయాలను పంచుకుంటారు.

programme.sub-title: A heartwarming coming-of-age story about a hatchling who grows to be a leader of her herd, helping ensure the survival of future generations
programme.desc: An eight-part docuseries exploring Earth's major eras and extinction events across 450 million years alongside the creatures who fought to survive.

programme.title: ఆఫ్రికాస్ ట్రీస్ ఆఫ్ లైఫ్
programme.sub-title: Explore the importance of the camel thorn in sub-Saharan Africa's ecosystem and the vital role it plays in providing sustenance and sanctuary for local animals
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు, సబ్-సహారా ఆఫ్రికా పర్యావరణంలో వివిధరకాల చెట్ల ప్రాముఖ్యత, స్థానిక జంతువుల జీవితంలో వాటి పాత్రను అన్వేషిస్తారు.

programme.title: ది అమెరికాస్
programme.sub-title: Mexico, where deserts meet tropics; see new footage of fledgling pygmy owls, orca hunting, new species in flooded caves and orchid bees filmed in incredible detail -- all revealing the hidden lives of unique wildlife
programme.desc: Tom Hanks narrates a 10-episode television event exploring the worlds and wildlife of North and South America, following amazing creatures across frozen mountains, barren deserts and dense jungles in awe-inspiring, never-before-seen footage.

programme.title: ఓకవాంగో: రివర్ ఆఫ్ డ్రీమ్స్
programme.sub-title: The extraordinary landscape and wildlife of the middle world of the Okavango River in Southern Africa
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు ఒకవాంగో నది పర్యావరణ వ్యవస్థపై సమగ్రమైన అంతర్దృష్టిని అందజేసి, విభిన్న వన్యప్రాణులను ప్రదర్శిస్తారు.

programme.title: ద కిల్
programme.sub-title: A pride of lionesses reigns supreme on the banks of a river in Tanzania. They are merciless hunters, unrivalled in their fearlessness and strength
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు టాంజానియాలోని ఒక నది ఒడ్డున నివసించే ఆడసింహాల గర్వం గురించి, మనుగడ కోసం అవి చేసే పోరాటం గురించి తెలియజేస్తారు.

programme.title: ది వ్యూ ఫ్రమ్ ఆన్ హై
programme.sub-title: Exploring how the meticulously planned architectural features of Saint Petersburg were constructed, with a particular focus on their sacral meanings
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు రష్యాలో రెండవ అతిపెద్ద నగరమైన సెయింట్ పీటర్స్‌బర్గ్ లోని చారిత్రక కట్టడాలు, భవనాల నిర్మాణాత్మక శైలిని చూపుతారు.

programme.title: వైల్డ్ క్యాట్స్
programme.sub-title: Explores the daily activities of predatory wild cats residing in the forests of America while capturing their unseen intimacy with their families
programme.desc: క్రూరమైన అడవి పిల్లులు చాలా సవాలుగా ఉన్న ప్రాంతాలలో మనుగడ కోసం పోరాడటానికి తమ అద్భుతమైన నైపుణ్యాలను ఉపయోగిస్తాయి.

programme.title: బిగ్ క్యాట్స్: యాన్ అమేజింగ్ యానిమల్ ఫ్యామిలీ
programme.sub-title: Patrick Aryee comes within a whisker of some of Earth's most majestic predators as he embarks on a remarkable journey through the feline family tree
programme.desc: ఒకజీవశాస్త్రవేత్త, అడవి ప్రాంతాన్ని పాలించే 37 రకాల పిల్లుల విజయాన్ని, వాటి వైవిధ్యమైన కుటుంబ వృక్షాన్ని వెలికితీస్తాడు.

programme.title: బిగ్ క్యాట్స్: యాన్ అమేజింగ్ యానిమల్ ఫ్యామిలీ
programme.sub-title: As Patrick Aryee delves into the feline family tree, the biologist witnesses gravity-defying 'catrobatics', tests the speed of a cheetah, and explores the odd-looking Pallas's cat

programme.title: ద జూ
programme.sub-title: Located just 10 miles from New York's Times Square, the Bronx Zoo is a recognised world leader in animal care and species conservation. It houses more than 6,000 animals and has a staff of 500-plus people dedicated to their care and well-being. Never before have camera crews been granted full access to the 265-acre campus, until production of the docuseries `The Zoo'. The results are stories focusing on dozens of animals and experiences at the facility, and its critical mission to conserve wildlife around the world. Episodes also highlight various employees and how their expertise and skills help provide top-quality care for the animals
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు అంతరించిపోతున్న జాతులను రక్షించడంలో, వన్యప్రాణులను సంరక్షించడానికి బ్రాంక్స్ జూ చేస్తున్న ప్రయత్నాలను చూపుతారు.

programme.title: క్రికీ! ఇట్స్ ద ఇర్విన్స్
programme.sub-title: Carrying on late wildlife conservationist Steve Irwin's mission to bring people closer to animals is now the mission of his family. Terri, Bindi and Robert Irwin return to Animal Planet, giving viewers access to their wildlife adventures around the world and the amazing animals that continue to inspire their conservation efforts. The series features the family caring for more than 1,200 animals at the Australia Zoo; overseeing a world-class wildlife hospital, the largest of its kind in the world; and conducting high-level global expeditions

programme.title: సర్వైవింగ్ ఎర్త్
programme.desc: From the producers of Walking with Dinosaurs comes an eight-part docuseries spanning 450 million years that revisits eight of Earth's major extinction events. Bringing some of the planet's most extraordinary geological eras to vivid life, the all-new footage created in partnership with real scientific insight explores the lives of animals we know and love, including mammoths, saber-toothed cats and dinosaurs, alongside some of evolution's truly unique creatures, like gorgonopsians, pliosaurs, glyptotherium and more. Together, they tell the story of how life has endured the impossible -- and never stopped fighting for survival.

programme.title: జపాన్స్ వైల్డ్ సైడ్
programme.sub-title: A filmmaker travels from Hokkaido's forests to the coastlines of Okinawa to discover the secrets of Japan's most iconic animals
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు జపాన్‌లోని ప్రసిద్ధ జంతువుల రహస్యాలను కనుగొనడానికి హోక్కైడో అడవుల నుండి ఒకినావా తీరప్రాంతాల వరకు ప్రయాణిస్తారు.

programme.sub-title: Take look at some of the tricks employed by cheetahs in order to protect themselves from the scorching sun in the wilderness
programme.desc: The filmmaker sheds light on the threat of the climate change in the hottest regions of the world and how the animals have adjusted themselves to the changing environment.

programme.sub-title: The filmmaker captures the extreme power play and struggle for survival between a pride of lions and a herd of hippos under the protection of a ferocious bull as night falls

programme.sub-title: Explore the landscapes and wildlife of Mexico, where deserts meet tropics, including footage of fledgling pygmy owls, orca hunting, new species in flooded caves, and orchid bees
programme.desc: Tom Hanks narrates a 10-episode television event from the executive producers of Planet Earth, exploring the extraordinary worlds and wildlife of North and South America. Scored by composer Hans Zimmer, the breathtaking journey follows amazing creatures living in their natural habitats across the supercontinent, including diverse terrains like the Atlantic Coast, Mexico, Wild West, Amazon, Frozen North, Gulf Coast, Andes, Caribbean, West Coast and Patagonia. Each location comes alive in never-before-seen footage showing the unique connectedness of the land that millions of people call home.

programme.title: సర్వైవింగ్ ఎర్త్
programme.desc: From the producers of Walking with Dinosaurs comes an eight-part docuseries spanning 450 million years that revisits eight of Earth's major extinction events. Bringing some of the planet's most extraordinary geological eras to vivid life, the all-new footage created in partnership with real scientific insight explores the lives of animals we know and love, including mammoths, saber-toothed cats and dinosaurs, alongside some of evolution's truly unique creatures, like gorgonopsians, pliosaurs, glyptotherium and more. Together, they tell the story of how life has endured the impossible -- and never stopped fighting for survival.

Bringing some of the planet's most extraordinary geological eras to vivid life, the all-new footage created in partnership with real scientific insight explores the lives of animals we know and love, including mammoths, saber-toothed cats and dinosaurs, alongside some of evolution's truly unique creatures, like gorgonopsians, pliosaurs, glyptotherium and more. Together, they tell the story of how life has endured the impossible -- and never stopped fighting for survival.

programme.desc: దర్శకుడు ప్రకృతి కాఠిన్యాన్ని భరించిన, విశాలమైన ప్రకృతి దృశ్యాలలో నివసించే కొన్ని బలమైన జంతువులను చూపుతారు.

programme.title: వైల్డ్ కింగ్డమ్స్

programme.title: బర్త్ ఆఫ్ స్పీడ్
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker traces the journey of two mother cheetahs, who strive to nurture and train their cubs to survive in the wild
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు, తమ పిల్లలను పోషించడానికి, శిక్షణ ఇవ్వడానికి ప్రయత్నించే రెండు తల్లి చిరుతల ప్రయాణాన్ని చూపుతారు.

programme.title: వ్యాలీ ఆఫ్ ఫ్లడ్ అండ్ ఫైర్
programme.sub-title: The end of November marks the finish of one of the toughest dry seasons on record, and triggers a transition from parched wilderness to lush wetland
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు వర్షాలు అభివృద్ధి చెందుతున్న పర్యావరణ వ్యవస్థగా మారుస్తున్న లుయాంగ్వా లోయలోని కాలానుగుణ మార్పులను చూపుతారు.

programme.title: వోల్వ్స్ అండ్ లయన్స్: ఓల్డ్ ఎనిమీస్
programme.sub-title: Wild predators employ a variety of predatory techniques. However, wolves rely upon an excellent sense of smell whilst cats confront stamina issues
programme.desc: కుక్క జాతి జంతువులు, పిల్లి జాతి జంతువుల తెలివితేటలు పోల్చి ఏ జాతి ఒక ప్రాంతాన్ని శాసిస్తుందో తెలుస్తుంది.

programme.title: క్యూట్ టు కిల్లర్
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker chronicles the journey of four cubs in Zimbabwe, home to Africa's top predators, as they grow from two weeks to three-year-old hunters, evolving from 'cute to killer'
programme.desc: ఆఫ్రికాలోని మాంసాహారులకు నిలయమైన జింబాబ్వేలో రెండు వారాల నుండి మూడేళ్ళ వేటగాళ్లుగా ఎదిగిన నాలుగు పిల్లలను చూపుతారు.

programme.title: ది హిప్పో కింగ్
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker sheds light on the not so well known story, the true nature and life of a seriously misunderstood and neglected mammal on earth, a giant hippo bull
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు ఒక పెద్ద హిప్పో బుల్ నిజమైన స్వభావం,అంతగా తెలియని జీవితంపై వివరిస్తారు.

programme.title: బిగ్ క్యాట్ టేల్స్
programme.sub-title: Chongo is unwilling to share the buffalo with the rest of the pride while Fig continues to give lessons to the young cub
programme.desc: మనుగడ, సహవాసం, వేట, సంతానం కోసం పోరాడే పెద్ద పిల్లుల జాతి రోజువారీ జీవితం గురించి ఓ బృందం చిత్రీకరిస్తారు.

programme.title: జస్ట్ యానిమల్స్
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker explores the interesting facets, physical features, behaviours and habitats of a wide variety of animal species
programme.desc: చిత్ర దర్శకుడు అనేక రకాల జంతువుల ఆవాసాలు, భౌతిక లక్షణాలు, ప్రవర్తనలు, ఆసక్తికర విషయాలను విశ్లేషిస్తారు.

programme.title: ద జూ
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker explores the lives of animals at the Bronx Zoo, showcasing the dedication of staff as they care for the creatures, protect endangered species and champion global wildlife conservation
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు అంతరించిపోతున్న జాతులను రక్షించడంలో, వన్యప్రాణులను సంరక్షించడానికి బ్రాంక్స్ జూ చేస్తున్న ప్రయత్నాలను చూపుతారు.

credits.actor: Jim Breheny,John Sykes,Annie Rivas,Kathleen LaMattina,Pat Thomas,Colleen McCann
